name: set_sidechain_send_gui
verified_note: Confirmed on FL 26.1.7 on 2026-10-21 (Insert 1 to Insert 2): select the source strip, right-click the send switch at the bottom of the destination strip, choose Sidechain to this track by picture (template mixer_sidechain_menu_item). The route must already exist (create_send_route), the mixer must be open with no plugin window covering the strips, and strips 1 to 16 are reachable without scrolling. Pixel values are for a 2560x1440 screen; anchors mixer_strip1_name and mixer_send1_switch are the first strip, 42 px apart.
summary: Turn an existing mixer send into a sidechain send.
source: measured on this install; FL manual: https://www.image-line.com/fl-studio-learning-content/fl-studio-online-manual/html/plugins/Fruity%20Limiter.htm
